editorial.blurb: A refreshingly unassuming Alpine-inspired spot in Logan Square where exceptional pork dishes and seasonal small plates shine with high-quality ingredients and impeccable execution.
editorial.insiderTip: Start with the cheese and charcuterie board, then order the Pork Schnitzel—a massive, tender signature that lives up to the hype. Don't skip the potato latkes or seasonal risotto options, and save room for the sticky toffee pudding.
